A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
, in most cases, pruning is a better architecture search method than a weight search method, and the latter is not necessary.
, in many cases, training a large model is not necessary, and a pruned network architecture itself can be directly trained from scratch.
, in the context of structured pruning, the value of pruning is in finding an efficient architecture, and the pruned weights do not necessarily contain any useful information for the pruned network.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, when pruning, one should directly train a target network architecture from scratch rather than using a three-stage pipeline.
, in the context of pruning, it may be more important to find the best architecture, than to find the best initialization for the architecture.
, for structured pruning methods, the pruned model architecture itself is the most important factor for performance.
